text: I wake up at six every morning. First, I stretch for five minutes, then shower and have a simple breakfast of oatmeal and coffee. By seven-thirty, I’m at my desk, working as a graphic designer. My schedule is consistent: I focus on projects until noon, take a short lunch break, and continue until five. After work, I go for a half-hour jog or do yoga—exercise helps me unwind. Evenings are quiet: I cook dinner, read, and sometimes call a friend. I’m usually in bed by ten. This routine keeps me balanced and productive.
